children: Yu Chen, the director and controlling person of Lianyi Holding Limited, disclosed a 34.12% stake in iOThree Limited. The Schedule 13D, accepted on Aug. 28, 2026, reflects Lianyi’s purchase of 1,034,483 Ordinary Shares funded by Chen’s personal capital. The sizable minority position gives Chen meaningful ownership while he states no plans to seek changes at the company.

Lianyi Holding Limited acquired the shares under a Securities Purchase Agreement dated Jan. 10, 2026, for US$900,000. The investors say they have “made no proposals” and have “entered into no agreements” that would trigger any of the change-in-control or strategic actions listed in Item 4, signaling a purely investment posture at this time.

Yu Chen is a Chinese business executive who serves as the director and controlling person of Lianyi Holding Limited, a Hong Kong shipping services company. He often invests through entities he controls and, in this case, used personal funds to finance the purchase. His approach favors taking significant minority stakes to back growth without immediately seeking board seats or governance changes.
